scope: Conditional analytic error-bound audit and prospective resolved-event contract only; no new astronomical conversion or production eligibility
freeze_rule: Commit before computed example results or audit tests. No retuning Mission 38 tolerances.
rules: Required absolute terms must be present exactly once; sum absolute bounds linearly, never RSS them
A bound is conditional on explicit evidence and domain; input declarations are not certified
Unknown terms retain null totals; a sample maximum or standard deviation is never an absolute bound
Physical-time inversion requires positive derivative lower bound across the full bracket, independent root existence/bracketing proof, and all model terms
No measured Mission 38 residual supplies a global derivative, physical bound or domain certificate
Clock inclusion is audited before adding an observer Einstein term; prevent double counting
Nominal numerical query membership is separate from stochastic timing uncertainty and observing eligibility
example_disclaimer: Illustrative supplied inequalities only: radius 1.1 au, distance 3e16 m, speed 31 km/s and slope 0.9998 are not certified for any AstroScope domain. Angular values are explicit conservative rounded inputs, not catalogue uncertainties.
numeric_policy: Fraction arithmetic on finite decimal-string inputs; exact rational outputs authoritative. Human decimal bounds round upward at 12 fractional places. No empirical scientific tolerance or accuracy acceptance threshold is introduced.
contract_policy: Prospective manifest of required fields, status transitions, eligibility prerequisites, monotone query enclosures, boundary rules, uncertainty transport and migration. Not a runtime serializer, parser, production resolved object or observing approval.
coverage_policy: Do not reclassify Mission 36 scenarios or Mission 37/38 historical evidence. New exact analytic tests establish only conditional arithmetic and contract consistency.

sources.role: Timing term taxonomy and geometric definitions; no borrowed accuracy claims
